Eastbrook University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
Emergency Department — Clerking Proforma
ED Clerking — 04/03/2020, 18:44
Hospital No: 0007ad27-973e-4cd5-8d46-b636b5bfa84
Doc: 0007ad27-973e-4cd5-8d46-b636b5bfa84ed_clerking
04/03/2020 18:44
Presenting complaint: Woman in her 20s-30s presenting with cough, fever and breathlessness,
re-attending the same day.
History: Initially assessed earlier today with similar symptoms; declined admission at that time.
Represents with worsening breathlessness and persistent fever. No significant past medical
history, non-smoker.
Observations: Temperature 38.2°C, HR 106 bpm, RR 24/min, BP 116/68 mmHg, SpO2 91% on air
recorded at 10:06 on 04/03/2020 at first attendance.
NEWS2 6.
Examination: Mildly tachypnoeic, bilateral basal crackles on auscultation, no wheeze. Alert,
no confusion.
Impression: Suspected viral pneumonia, likely COVID-19 given clinical picture and current
outbreak; Isolation in side room.
Plan: Declined admission on first assessment and re-presented later the same day for
admission. Admit under medicine for oxygen therapy, monitoring and swab for SARS-CoV-2 PCR
to be sent. Admitted to hospital at 17:13 on 04/03/2020. VTE risk assessment: high risk given
acute illness and reduced mobility, thromboprophylaxis to be prescribed once admission bloods
reviewed. Chest X-ray and routine bloods requested including FBC, CRP, U&E, D-dimer. Isolation
in side room. Escalation plan and ceiling of care to be discussed with the medical team on the
ward.
ED Clerking
